#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int countInsertions(const std::string& s, int index) {
    if (index >= (int)s.length()) {
        return 0;
    }
    int end = index;
    while (end < (int)s.length() && s[end] == s[index]) {
        end++;
    }
    int runLength = end - index;
    int count = (runLength % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    return count + countInsertions(s, end);
}

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int insertions = countInsertions(s, 0);
    std::cout << insertions << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
